title: Glessner's two carved crosses now cut into the chimney stone
items: The two small crosses beside the 1886 date stone on the Glessner house's 18th Street chimney are now cut into the rough stone, as the 1965 survey photograph shows them. Before, they were drawn flat at the stone's highest point, so they hovered an inch or two in front of it, and from the north-east one hung in the sky past the chimney's edge.
